answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Each submission hangs on the lotus of a task receipt, and the sparrow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the island of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
